lines.quote: Developed and tested a spatial filtering framework for wideband sensor arrays in a laboratory setting, demonstrating 18 dB interference suppression across the 1–6 GHz band using a 4-element test array.
Implemented delay-and-sum and basic MVDR/Capon beamformers in MATLAB, steering nulls to suppress a known 2.4 GHz interference source.

I wrote the data pre-processing module for our field-deployable receiver unit in C, running on a Xilinx Zynq SoC, handling decimation and channelisation before the data hits the main processing chain.

I built an automated calibration verification pipeline in Python that our production team now runs before every receiver ships -- about 3,000 lines pulling measurement data from the network analyser, running pass/fail checks against specs, and generating a certificate PDF.

Conducted RF front-end characterisation and S-parameter measurements for the BSN-400 L-band receiver using a Rohde & Schwarz ZVA vector network analyser, identifying impedance mismatches causing 2.3 dB insertion loss in the feed network.

Designed and implemented extended Kalman filter modules for multi-target tracking in the company's ground-based radar processing pipeline, handling state estimation for up to 40 simultaneous tracks at a 10 Hz update rate.
